# Plan: Settings Page UI redesign (design-reviewed)

## Context
The account-settings form already ships with an approved shell, components, and
behavior spec (PLAN.md + DESIGN.md). The implementation drifted from DESIGN.md in
five places: undifferentiated Save button, uneven section spacing, an error
surface below WCAG AA contrast, three label font sizes, and no pending indicator
on Save. This plan brings the form back into conformance with the checked-in
design system without visual exploration or component replacement.

Review mode: text-only (mockups skipped by user request), native review only
(outside voices skipped by user request), all seven design passes.

## Accepted behavior (inherited unchanged from PLAN.md + DESIGN.md)
- Single-column settings shell, 640px max width. Persistent app navigation, then
  `main`: "Account settings" (h1) + description "Manage your display name, email
  address, and notification preferences." (verbatim), action group
  Save | Reset | Cancel | Export, InlineStatus, Profile (h2) fieldset (Display
  name, Email), Notifications (h2) fieldset (Weekly digest, Product tips).
  h2s label fieldsets via aria-labelledby; no heading level skipped.
- Reuse existing Button, Field, InlineStatus, ErrorSummary, ConfirmationDialog.
  No new component family. Font stays system-ui, sans-serif, inherited by controls.
- Defaults for a new account: account name/email, Weekly digest on, Product tips
  off. Initial load uses the existing form skeleton. Read failure shows Retry
  (aria-label "Retry loading").
- InlineStatus: role=status, aria-live=polite, aria-atomic=true. Blank before the
  first successful save; "Unsaved changes" when any field differs from saved;
  "Saved at HH:mm" (local 24h) after success; revert-all or confirmed Reset
  restores the prior text (timestamp or blank). Failed save keeps "Unsaved
  changes" beside the error.
- Save is atomic. Repeat submissions disabled while pending. Save and Export
  mutually exclusive; Reset and Cancel disabled while either is pending; all
  four re-enable on settle. Export downloads latest successfully saved
  preferences as JSON; pending Export shows the inline spinner beside
  "Exporting…" inside its disabled button, aria-busy=true, reduced-motion safe.
- Errors: validation beside fields plus linked ErrorSummary (aria-describedby),
  focus first invalid field. Network/Export failures preserve edits and show
  Retry as a sibling button outside the live region, visible text "Retry",
  aria-label "Retry save" / "Retry export". Export success clears only the
  Export error.
- Dialogs: Reset → "Discard unsaved changes?" / "Your saved preferences will be
  restored." Actions "Keep editing" (default) / "Discard changes". Cancel uses
  the same dialog with "Discard and leave". Focus trapped, Escape cancels,
  focus returns to the trigger when staying; confirmed navigation focuses the
  destination main heading.
- Responsive: above 640px, actions in one row. At 640px and below, full-width
  Save first, then Reset | Cancel | Export in one equal-column row, DOM/tab
  order preserved, fits 320px with 44px targets and no horizontal scroll.
- A11y: 44px targets, focus-visible 2px solid #1d4ed8 outline offset 2px
  (measured contrast > 3:1) on every control and dialog action, semantic
  fieldsets/labels, main landmark, heading order, reduced motion respected.

## Review findings (each remedy PENDING until individually approved)

| # | Pass | Gap (current implementation) | Proposed remedy (DESIGN.md) | Status |
|---|------|------------------------------|-----------------------------|--------|
| 1 | 1 Info Arch | Save has same size/weight/color as Reset, Cancel, Export; no visible primary action | Save = only filled primary (#1d4ed8, white text); Reset/Cancel/Export = neutral ghost buttons | APPROVED (D2 → 1A) |
| 2 | 2 States | Save pending 2-5s with no indicator; page looks frozen | Inline spinner beside "Saving…" inside the disabled Save button, aria-busy=true, reduced-motion support (same pattern Export already uses) | PENDING |
| 3 | 5 Design Sys | Section gaps are 16/24/32px, no rhythm | 8px base: sections 32px, field groups 24px, label-to-input 8px | PENDING |
| 4 | 5 Design Sys | Labels use 14/16/18px | Two roles only: 16px body/labels/helper, 20px section headings | PENDING |
| 5 | 6 A11y | Error text on light pink at ~3:1 contrast, below WCAG AA | error.text #991b1b on error.surface #fef2f2 with icon and explicit text; all text meets AA | PENDING |

## Pass scores
Recorded as passes run. Format: initial → after approved fixes.

| Pass | Initial | After | Notes |
|------|---------|-------|-------|
| 1 Information Architecture | 7 | 10 | Page order was already exact; approving filled Save + ghost secondaries gives the header one anchor |
| 2 Interaction States | — | — | |
| 3 User Journey | — | — | |
| 4 AI Slop Risk | — | — | |
| 5 Design System Alignment | — | — | |
| 6 Responsive & A11y | — | — | |
| 7 Unresolved Decisions | n/a | n/a | register only |

questions.question:
D1 — Review all 7 design passes, or focus on specific ones?
Project/branch/task: gstack-plan-count-Wg2rCj on main, reviewing the settings-form conformance plan.
ELI10: I rated the plan 6/10. The behavior spec is thorough, but the built form still breaks the design system in five known places (which button is primary, uneven spacing, an error box that is hard to read, three label sizes, and a Save button that gives no feedback for 2-5 seconds). Each pass looks for gaps like these and any others the plan missed. Stakes if we pick wrong: focusing narrowly could leave an unlisted gap for the implementer to guess at.
Recommendation: A because you asked for all seven dimensions and the five known gaps span four different passes.
Completeness: A=10/10, B=6/10
A) All 7 passes (recommended)
  ✅ Every known gap gets its own decision, plus a sweep for anything the plan missed
  ✅ Produces the storyboard, state table, and decision register the implementer needs
  ❌ Five to seven individual decision questions before the report is done
B) Only the passes that hold the five listed gaps (1, 2, 5, 6)
  ✅ Faster: skips Journey, AI Slop, and the decision register
  ✅ Still resolves every gap the plan already names
  ❌ Misses unlisted gaps and the storyboard; Pass 3 and 4 have no output
Net: full coverage costs a few more questions; a partial pass saves minutes but leaves blind spots.

questions.question:
D2 — Issue 1: How should the header make Save the visible primary action?
Project/branch/task: gstack-plan-count-Wg2rCj on main, Pass 1 Information Architecture.
ELI10: Right now Save, Reset, Cancel, and Export look identical. A user scanning the header cannot tell which one commits their edits, so some will hit Reset or Cancel by mistake and lose work, or hunt for Save. DESIGN.md already says Save is the only filled button and the rest are ghost buttons. Stakes if we pick wrong: mis-clicks on destructive neighbors and a header that reads as four equal choices.
Recommendation: 1A because it is the exact DESIGN.md token, reuses the existing Button variants, and makes Save the one anchor in the header.
Completeness: 1A=10/10, 1B=7/10, 1C=3/10
1A) Save filled #1d4ed8 with white text; Reset, Cancel, Export as neutral ghost buttons (recommended) (human: ~1h / CC: ~5min)
  ✅ One visual anchor; the eye lands on Save before reading any label
  ✅ Exact DESIGN.md token, so no new color or variant enters the system
  ❌ Ghost buttons must still hit 44px targets and 3:1 border contrast; needs a check at 320px
1B) Save filled, but keep Reset/Cancel/Export as today's filled neutral style (human: ~30min / CC: ~3min)
  ✅ Smaller diff: only Save's variant changes
  ✅ Save still reads as primary against three gray siblings
  ❌ Diverges from DESIGN.md's ghost spec, so four filled shapes still compete for weight
1C) Leave all four identical and rely on position (Save first) (human: 0 / CC: 0)
  ✅ No code change
  ✅ DOM order already puts Save first
  ❌ Position alone fails the 3-second scan test and leaves the documented gap open
Net: 1A costs a few minutes and closes the gap with the system's own tokens; anything less leaves the header ambiguous.

options.label: 1A Filled Save, ghost others (recommended)
options.description: Save #1d4ed8/white as the only filled button; Reset, Cancel, Export neutral ghost. Exact DESIGN.md spec.

options.label: 1B Filled Save, filled neutral others
options.description: Only change Save; keep the other three as filled neutral buttons. Deviates from DESIGN.md.

options.label: 1C Leave as is
options.description: No change; rely on Save being first in order. Gap stays open.
